General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2014Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: In the Annual Review (AR), progress against the Performance Assessment Framework (PAF) is assessed and agreed for the fiscal year preceding the report. In this case FY 2012/13. GBS is disbursed in the beginning of the fiscal year, in this case in July 2012 and thus the AR for 2013 is relevant for the last phase of this contribution. For more information see the AR 2013 in saved documents.
Overall performance against PAF 2013 was rated as satisfactory, but has seen a slight decline compared to 2012. Overall achievement of PAF 2013 was 56%, based on the 41 KPA and OI that were rated. Seven Outcome Indicators were not rated, either because the data was not available or the methodology was not agreed at the time of the rating.
Achieve¬ment of key policy actions is more positive than of outcome indicators: eight of twelve key policy actions were rated as achieved. Slightly more than half of the outcome indicators (15.5 of 29) that were rated were achieved.
a) Harmonized performance tranche
Six out of seven indicators in the harmonized performance tranche received a positive rating, which will impact the firm commitments for budget support in financial year 2014/15:
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
